name: Flaxseed
description: Oily seed ground into winter pinnis and porridges.

ayurveda.note: Alsi is classically ushna — a winter laddu seed.

effects.note: A randomised trial in constipated people with type 2 diabetes found ground flaxseed outperformed psyllium on overall constipation-symptom improvement at a matched dose; a separate trial found it beat a lactulose laxative on weekly bowel-movement count. It has to be ground — whole seeds pass through largely undigested. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
